reviews.comment: Truly the best professor I've had at A&M. Prof Carroll is so caring about the subject matter, and every lecture was very interesting and well-prepared. He offered some extra credit assignments, and didn't curve beyond this. All of the quizzes on material were very fair, and the written assignment was given well before the due date.

Incredible professor! Attendance was mandatory for lectures, but I loved going, and he always was prepared and commanded attention in-lecture. His passion for what he taught was easily seen in every lecture. No curves, but exams and the one written assignment were very fair. Take this prof!!
Excellent professor sad to see him go onto bigger things!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: he is such an amazing professor! if he comes back to teach at A&M again, TAKE HIS CLASS. take hist 230 or hist 106 for FUN. he's THAT good. witty, passionate, intellectual in various aspects. and he cares deeply for all his students! the material is intriguing and interesting, and he presents is so well.
Easily the best teacher I've ever had. Professor Carroll's lectures made me want to wake up for his 8am class. It was a pleasure to have him, and I'm sad to see him go.

Dr. Carroll showed me that when you worry less about the grade and more about the material, and the why and the how, you start to see the bigger picture. HIST 230 is such an important subject not only as a student but for understanding policy-making, military history, and American strategy. He lights the curiosity to learn more outside of class.
Amazing lecturer, attendance is mandatory but his lectures are engaging! Going to miss him at TAMU!

Professor Carroll is the best professor I have ever had at TAMU! I had him two semesters in a row (HIST 107 & HIST 230), and I would happily have him again! He's extremely knowledgable, absolutely hilarious, and truly cares about you. He knows how to convince you that you can succeed at anything. Best of all he is IRISH!
The best professor I have ever taken

Professor Caroll was such a great professor. All he wanted was for his students to succeed. I had to take a makeup exam for my first exam and he was so kind and sat down with me and talked about my problems. He was truly such a great professor and treated all his students like his children! His exams were clear and concise.

This man is the best Professor at the school. I'm sad to see him go I'm happy for him! Funniest guy I've ever met. He really cares about his students. Sometimes I regret not taking history at a community college during the summer but all those regrets went away when I took his class! I am truly grateful for having had this class with him!

HANDS DOWN ONE OF MY FAV CLASSES AND PROFS! You will learn such an enriched version of history that is truly so interesting. Prof Carol is a world class educator and makes lecture so fun! He really deserves a raise! Pay attention in class, do the extra credit and get to know the prof and you will do good in the class!

Professor Carroll cares immensely for all of his students and has been by far my favorite professor I have had at A&M! Attendance is mandatory, but the interesting lectures provided by Prof Carroll are worth it. The class is graded on 4 non-cumulative exams and a written assignment, with extra credit opportunities offered after each class.

THE BEST PROFESSOR AT TEXAS A&M. PLEASE if you have the chance TAKE HIM!!!! He truly cares about each of his students and will get to know your name. His lectures are so entertaining!! Go to class and take notes because that is when the tests are over. He offers EC opportunities after each lesson. He is AWESOME and HILARIOUS.

Class driven by lectures, so you have to show up if you expect a good grade.  Professor Carroll is a nice guy & a good teacher, but not as good as he probably thinks he is. You get funny and entertaining, but also a big ego to go along with it.  Lectures are good, but says "okay" and "alright" way too much, which can be annoying. Good slides.

Take Professor Carroll if you can! His lectures are engaging and extremely interesting for post-Civil War American History. Attendance is mandatory, except for three unexcused absences, but you won't want to miss class. He does not get political or force ideologies, gives you the facts, and lets you decide what you side with. 4 non-cumulative tests

Professor Carrol is a hilarious lecturer and is capable of holding the class' attention for an entire hour and fifteen minute lecture. He does not curve his exams, however, it is incredibly easy to get an A as long as you take notes and read them before the exam.

Beginning of course he says we need to all agree to leave politics at the door: he gives "just the facts"; proceeds to spend the entire course pushing racial politics and feminism and smearing Christianity.
Four tests and an essay on a film, 20% each; nothing hard. Attendance required so you must listen to him insult your culture for 3 hours/week.

Only need to study lecture slides. However there's only exams and a paper assignment.
 No book reading needed to pass.
Lectures are engaging and interesting, with extra information just for entertainment. 
There's extra credit that add up to 5% of your total grade. 
If you attend class and study class slides easy A. 
Exams are easy if you study.

Such a great professor, always making jokes and makes the lectures fun and interesting. There are participation quizzes in each class for extra credit. No exams just quizzes and a paper. I didn't know anything about military history and this easily became my favorite class.

An amazing prof. Constantly making cracks about Ireland and Chic-Fil-A. He graded the class by quizzes, with no tests. Quizzes were very specific in their questions; they would ask about names and specific battles rather than their outcomes or significance. Had to write a 10 page paper, but it wasn't too terrible. Would take again any day.

This Irish legend, despite having a terrible opinion on Chik fil A, was one of my favorite history profs. His lectures were engaging, and he thoroughly explains things. Just listen to what he says and dont wait too long to start the semester essay. You can skip class if you want, but youll do better on his quizzes if you actually go.

LOVE this professor. He's a solid 10/10 person and a solid 10/10 professor. No exams, but there are quizzes very frequently and one big writing exam at the end of the year. I would take this class again just to sit in the lecture with this professor! I would definitely study for the quizzes.

The best teacher I had last semester. He makes all the material extremely engaging . Even though it wasn't mandatory to go to class, I always went because he made the information interesting and his lectures were funny. The tests are really easy and straight from the PowerPoints.

By far the best professor I've ever had. He's hilarious, caring, and accommodating. Make sure to go to the lectures, because the tests are strictly off of the lectures. Lectures are very fun, so you won't get bored. I received a bad grade in the class because of personal illnesses where I missed class a lot, but TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: My favorite Professor so far! He has interesting lectures and he is so funny. He makes class fun and entertaining! Tests are pretty straightforward if you study the notes.

Professor Carroll was my favorite professor this semester. He is very fair and his letters are genuinely enjoyable given the subject. If you put in the work you will get a good grade. He does not try to trick you on exams or with any of his quiz questions. WHEN HE SAYS DO THE EXTRA CREDIT YOU DO IT.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He has been one of my favorite profs so far! He is absolutely hilarious, and he makes class incredibly fun.

Dr. Carroll is an outstanding professor! I took him for HIST 102 and genuinely enjoyed his lectures. The lectures may seem heavy at first, but as long as you take notes on them, you should do well on the tests. He is also very responsive and will help you succeed if you ask questions and participate. 10/10 recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures
